translation: Yɔrɔgɔnw ni wolonwula kɔnɔ, o ye ɲɔgɔn fa filanan ye; bato misiw — Ebezɛr dugu sigilen bɛ Yerushalayim kɔrɔyan fan fɛ, Taditaw bɛ o fɛ; nka an bɛ nin jate bila Yerushalayim jamanuw la. Ni i ye tɔgɔw sɛbɛn Yuwada faamaw la, Yuwada denw na, u kɔrɔlenw tɔgɔw na, i b'u ye Aliya bɛɛ la, minnu nana Babilɔni, a y'u lase Yusua, Nebemi, Asɛrɛbaya, Yeremiya, Yahasɛrɛ, Adaya, Yonatan, Zɛkɛrɛ, Azɛrɛlɛ walisa ka tugu — u tɛmɛ ka kɛ masakɛ Daryawes jate ye, Yuwada ka nɔnabila Aliya misiri dɔ. Tɔgɔ minnu bɛ dugaw na, u ka yɛrɛ tɛ jate; sabu Babilɔn dɔgba Nebutan-Adan ka u ta ka lase Yuwada jamana na. Nin ye tɔgɔw ye: Parɔsh, Pasɛrim, Arahu, Pahati-Mowab, Eloyimi, Zatu, Bekari, Inbi, Aginab, Bigeway, Adin, Ebigayid, Adonika, Bigeway, Adin, Ater-Hizikiya, Yubi, Hasan, Bɛzɛlɛlɛ, Yonifanɛ, Meta, Harimu, Bɛzɛlɛlɛ, Mesizabɛlɛ, Sarayi, Aserɛ, Yeremɛ, Yonatan, Yakin, Yusua, Eserɛmi, Emarima, Putiri, Hasan, Mahasɛrɛ, Baruku, Sɛrɛbiya, Hananiya, Hanan, Maluki, Harumu, Bɛzɛlɛlɛ. Nɔnabila minnu tɛ tɔgɔ sɛbɛn, u bɛ jira ko aliya tɛmɛnenw ye: Dɛlawaya, Towa, Kɛlaya, Yonatan, Yaji, Palaya, Sarayi, Reya, Bɛzɛlɛlɛ, Yaji, Harimu, Yonatan. Liwi minnu: Yusua, Binnuya, Kadimiɛlɛ. Sarakasebagaw: Yeruwaba, Yusua, Kadimiɛlɛ, Banaya, Binuya, Kɛnani. Yɔrɔgɔnw ni wolonwula kɔnɔ fila ɲɔgɔn na; bato misiw — Ebezɛrɛ, Taditaw, Yeruwaba, Asaraya, Raamu, Kenani, Hananan, Hanani, Zɛkɛrɛ, Yonatan, Maluki, Yanai, Sasibaya, Kalifi, Asaraya, Reza, Yeruwaba, Yonatan, Yaji, Matani, Zɛkɛrɛ, Sasibaya, Binuya, Sɛrɛbiya, Hananiya, Hanan, Hananiah, Harumu, Yeruwaba, Ananiya, Maluki, Yonatan, Asaraya, Hanani, Yonatan, Maluki, Yanai, Sasibaya, Kalifi, Asaraya, Reza. Nin ye jate ye: sankolo dɔgɔtɔrɔw, Yerushalayim mɔgɔw, Ebezɛrɛ dugu mɔgɔw, Aliya denw — minnu nana Babilɔni dɔgba Nebukanɛsɛrɛ fanga la, u y'a lase Yuwada jamana na. — Ni o kɔfɛ, sira tilennen na: Yerushalayim jamanuw bɛ sira jɔ, bɛɛ ye bɔ bɛɛ na. Nin sira in ye dɔgɔyakɔrɔba ye min bɛ jira. — {7:68} Gamelɛw, ɔɔɔ — jatebaga ye sɛbɛn fɔ: gamelɛw tɛmɛna kelen-kelen. — Yɔrɔgɔn caman: Gambiw ni misi tɛmɛna. Nin jatew ye sɛbɛn ye; ale ye sɛbɛn dɔ ye. — Ni i bɛ tɔgɔw ta, i bɛ u ta cogo min na, ni i bɛ u sɛbɛn, ale ye jate ye. Ni tɔgɔ dɔ tɛ yen, o tɛ jate ye.
